newsitem.title: USA: Centennial hit by 2 more class-action suits.
newsitem.headline: Centennial hit by 2 more class-action suits.

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc had two more class-action lawsuits filed against it Wednesday, a day after it fired its chief executive and reported possible irregularities in its financial statements.

A suit filed in U.S. District Court in Massachusetts alleges Centennial and some of its senior officers misrepresented the company's operating results for the year ending June 30, 1996, and the first two quarters of 1997, according to the New York law firm of Wolf Popper LLP.
A similar suit was filed in the same court by the law firm of Savett Frutkin Podell & Ryan, of Philadelphia.
Another class-action suit making similar allegations was filed Wednesday.
Trading in Centennial's stock has been halted since Monday, when it closed at 16-3/8.

Centennial, of Billerica, Mass., has fired Chief Executive Officer Emanuel Pinez, relieved its chief financial officer of his duties and reported possible irregularities to the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company makes personal computer cards.
